question: Can a source-free tokenless system learn an unknown three-input causal operator from noisy interventions across worlds and reuse a compact cold-restorable operator memory on unseen input permutations without copying a hand-given operator library?
hypothesis: On disjoint B operator/worlds with same budgets, top-eight posterior operator memory from 48 training worlds improves unseen-action Brier at least 15% versus no cross-world learning and trained frequency baseline, while achieving Brier <=1.10x the better of exact hierarchical 256-table Bayes and exact true-generator 210-table Bayes, accuracy no more than 2pp below that exact Bayes, memory saved and cold-restored bit-exactly, and <=1/16 table enumeration at test time. This is development evidence of reusable finite operator learning, NOT open-ended function-invention or scientific superiority.

predecessor_evidence.note: YNCA09 joint structural graph learning improves independent MAP but remains worse than exact Bayes and assumes XOR operator; branch remains draft/unmerged.
CKAD integrated native learner is separate and untouched.

inputs.name: Synthetic previously unlisted operator from all 256 3-input Boolean truth tables, excluding 46 known standard operator truth tables; 48 noisy training worlds and disjoint test cohorts

A.status: Already run locally exploratory prior to this prereg; never relabel as confirmatory

frozen_design.grammar: 3-bit input x in 0..7 and all 256 binary truth tables as permissible *hypotheses*, with heldout true operator sampled from 210 tables outside a fixed 46-template familiar library; 6 hidden per-world input permutations. No true operator table or permutation supplied to any fitted policy.
frozen_design.mechanism: Pass A untrained independent per-world exact posterior with uniform prior. Targeted Pass B: train reusable posterior across 48 worlds using only sampled action-outcome pairs while marginalizing unknown permutations; retain only top 8 learned operator tables, serialize memory and restore, then infer unknown per-world permutation using 3 new noisy samples.
controls: Untrained exact per-world uniform 256-table Bayesian posterior; no transfer (reference)
Fully trained per-action frequency memory using same 48 worlds and three test observations
Fully trained exact hierarchical 256-table Bayes over identical training worlds and test observations
Exact generator-aware Bayesian 210-table posterior with correctly specified out-of-library prior
Privileged true-table Oracle diagnostic; not eligible for claims of superiority
frozen_design.evaluation: Brier and threshold accuracy ONLY across five unobserved 3-bit intervention assignments in each test world, averaged over independent worlds. Operator inference never receives true table/permutation. All methods have identical sampled observations; fixed noise .1. Report posterior orbit mass only as diagnostic using evaluator truth.
frozen_design.model_capacity: Candidate keeps exactly 8 operator tables and weights after 256-table fit; fully trained exact Bayes retains 256 or 210 weights; candidate and exact Bayes share same 48-world fitting cost, candidate reduces only per-test-world table/permutation inference. Count likelihood factors, do not claim a measured energy speedup.
frozen_design.compute_budget: Python 3.12 stdlib, <=20 min GitHub hosted Linux and Windows each, deterministic SHA, no paid API/GPU/owner runners.
frozen_design.source_rule: Commit source, tests, prereg source hash/bindings before first B run; B evaluated once per OS; never reuse B for tuning.
frozen_design.reserved_shift: None; no further autonomous expansion of this cohort after B.

metrics: Brier vs fully trained empirical frequency
Top-K stored operator weights and true-orbit posterior mass
Table/permutation likelihood-factor count estimates and test-time 256/8 compression
Linux/Windows original output SHA and tests

classification_rules.supported: DEVELOPMENT_SIGNAL iff compact learned operator memory beats BOTH untrained exact per-world and fully trained frequency by >=15% Brier on B, Brier <=1.10x better of generator-aware exact Bayes and full 256-table exact Bayes, within 2 percentage points of strongest exact Bayes accuracy, top8 memory restores bit-exactly and >=16x fewer table hypotheses at test time. This is NOT proof of scientific intelligence superiority or operator invention outside finite search space.
classification_rules.mixed: At least 10% Brier improvement vs untrained and frequency baselines, but insufficient exact Bayesian parity or accuracy: DEVELOPMENT_MIXED; stop this fixed prototype after bounded B.
classification_rules.negative: No improvement over trained frequency baseline, source-invalid, or harmful accuracy loss: DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO; stop rather than iterate after two passes.
classification_rules.invalid: Source or prereg hash mismatch, B executed before source freeze, hidden truth leaked into inference, unauthorized threshold change, unequal test observations, differing Linux/Windows outputs, any after-B tuning, or protected original science consumed.

prohibited_after_primary_run: Change B model hyperparameters/thresholds after observing B
Run another B seed or reuse B to tune
Call compressed exact Bayesian inference a new cognitive operator beyond all 256 Boolean tables
Replace native CKAD learner, owner, controllers or accepted refs
Claim physical compute/energy improvement from likelihood factor counts
preregistration_note: Executable and nine focused A-only tests committed and hash-locked BEFORE unseen B-world test outcomes. A consumed before initial prereg, remains exploratory. B classification uses all prereg controls including 15% improvement versus trained frequency even if program decision flag omits it. Cold restore must be checked in a SECOND process using saved learned weights.
